requirements.acceptance: Python 3.12 with pinned pytest and Requests
requirements.rationale: An incompatible interpreter or base library can invalidate every result before application behavior is assessed.

requirements.acceptance: Health response satisfies the API health contract
requirements.rationale: An unavailable service prevents intended use and makes downstream failures difficult to attribute.

requirements.acceptance: Both model names exist with nonempty digests
requirements.rationale: Missing models or unidentified weights invalidate reproducible model comparisons.

requirements.acceptance: Valid key is accepted; missing and invalid keys are rejected
requirements.rationale: Accepting unauthorized developer calls exposes application resources and test data.

requirements.description: Test resources can be created and cleaned up
requirements.acceptance: Workspace settings match and finalizer verifies absence
requirements.rationale: Leaked or shared mutable resources contaminate later tests and leave uncontrolled application state.

requirements.description: Uploaded policy is indexed and searchable
requirements.acceptance: Workspace attachment and vector search return policy anchors
requirements.rationale: Missing or unrelated retrieved policy passages make grounded answer acceptance unreliable.

requirements.description: Reviewed policy answers preserve facts and acknowledge missing information
requirements.acceptance: All declared golden cases meet required/forbidden/source criteria on both models
requirements.rationale: Incorrect benefits or invented missing information can mislead users about the fictional policy.

requirements.description: Versioned prompt changes preserve reviewed policy answers
requirements.acceptance: Every golden case passes with baseline and candidate on both models
requirements.rationale: A prompt change can silently weaken factual accuracy or missing-information behavior.

requirements.description: Curated attacks do not override policy expectations
requirements.acceptance: All attack cases preserve golden acceptance; document attacks prove captured exposure
requirements.rationale: Untrusted instructions can redirect generation away from the reviewed policy.

requirements.description: Employee descriptors do not change uniform entitlements
requirements.acceptance: Every paired variant passes the same reviewed policy criteria
requirements.rationale: Uniform policy entitlements should not depend on irrelevant employee descriptors.

requirements.description: Policy answers and sources remain usable through the UI
requirements.acceptance: Answer/source display, missing information, source passages and reload persistence pass
requirements.rationale: Users must see the accepted answer, supporting evidence and persisted conversation.

requirements.description: Saved paid-leave evidence meets explicit experimental gates
requirements.acceptance: Facts, sources and all four validated semantic metrics meet configured gates
requirements.rationale: A single dimension can hide weaknesses in grounding, correctness or retrieval; missing evidence must fail closed.

requirements.description: Declared bounded workloads meet latency and error criteria
requirements.acceptance: Health and RAG batches meet recorded thresholds and preserve RAG correctness
requirements.rationale: Long waits and request errors reduce usability; concurrent requests must preserve answer acceptance.
